text: When your child shows readiness for the toilet, help with cleaning (istinja') and handwashing until they learn them, gently introduce entering with the left foot and leaving with the right, and say the du'a for entering and leaving, without forcing memorization or blame.

review_defects.why: The English omits 'gradually' (تدريجياً), which softens the expectation and matches the child's pace.
The Arabic specifies no blame 'upon forgetting' (عند النسيان), but the English drops that condition, making the prohibition on blame sound broader than intended.
